cover.report_type: Year-End Report: January 31 of each year

_meta.notes: Older pre-2006 form (title carries no year); Column B is headed 'Year-to-Date Total'. Lines 1, 2 (both columns), 4 and 6 are hand-drawn slashed zeros. Lines 3, 5 and 7 are NEGATIVE, written in accounting parentheses with the cents as a raised superscript over a rule - transcribed (413.85) / (413.85) / ($413.85); on Line 7 the opening parenthesis is drawn through a dollar sign, hence the '($' form. Kept verbatim, including parentheses. A companion filing (lgardner_dissolution.pdf) explains this balance as a loan from Lee Gardner to his own campaign.
